note: PUBLIC-SAFE EXAMPLE. The real file lives at <control_root>/context-read/tools.v0.json and is Owner-placed; every value below is a placeholder. The read CLI pins this file by digest and prints the first 12 hex of it in its output head, so a changed tool set is visible in the answer rather than only in a log.

mail_attachments_layout.note: The mail collector records an absolute local_path per attachment and no repository module declares where those paths live, so the roots are declared here. A stored path outside every declared root is access_denied — the read never widens a root to reach a file.

shared_terms_note: OPTIONAL and absolute. The derived, regenerable registry of terms that occur in more than one project, built by the shared-terms slice. The voice read marks each interval with the registry terms it contains -- 공통(과제 N개) or 구별 -- so a reader stops treating a word several projects share as the one that picks a project. Omit the field and the marking is simply absent; the rule that a candidate needs two independent kinds of corroboration does not depend on it.
derived_root_hold_reason: The path registry places derived extracts under the project store 20_문서검색/본문·표_추출. That area accepts writes only through the graph index store, which refuses any path outside generations/<id>/ and admits only the binding write_authority actor for prepare/index. A read CLI running as the reader actor with purpose context_query has no admitted write surface there, so the cache stays outside the store until an Owner decision gives that area a second writer.
